prose: A one-beat tooling note from Simon Willison: datasette-llm 0.1a9 now picks up the default model configured in LLM, so Datasette Agent works out of the box - uvx --with datasette-agent datasette content.db --internal internal.db - without explicitly setting a model. Bigger Datasette Agent upgrades are promised soon.
highlights: datasette-llm 0.1a9 inherits LLM's default model - no more explicit -s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model
Datasette Agent now runs with a single uvx command
Larger Datasette Agent upgrades are in the pipeline
